title: Brake feel and engine braking behavior
summary: Reviews in this topic discuss brake performance and pedal feel, with a few clear compliments, a couple of direct complaints, and many fragments that mention braking behavior without a fully explicit sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that the brakes feel unprogressive or abrupt and that the pedal has too much movement.
